title_ar: الشيخ الددو يترأس الحفل الختامي لمركز تكوين العلماء للعام الدراسي 1437هـ
title_en: Sheikh al-Dedew Chairs the Closing Ceremony of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars for the Academic Year 1437 AH
body_ar:
ترأس فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو ـ حفظه الله تعالى ـ مساء اليوم الثلاثاء 28 شوال 1437هـ الموافق 2016/08/02م، الحفل الختامي لمركز تكوين العلماء للعام الدراسي 1437هـ، الموافق 2015/2016م تحت شعار "المثابرة سر النجاح".

وقد بدأ فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو رئيس المركز كلمته مرحبا بالحضور الكريم ومن دعوا ولم يستطيعوا الحضور داعيا الله أن يتقبل من الجميع،

ذاكرا أن حضورهم الليلة هو تتويج لعمل المركز ولطلابه الذي بذلوا جهودهم وتعلموا، مضيفا أن معدل الحفظ اليومي لدى طلاب المركز يقارب ثلاثة عشر حديثا ومائة وثلاثة عشر بيتا من المنظومات إضافة إلى حفظ الكتب النثرية الأخرى.

وذكر الشيخ رسالة المركز المختصرة في أربع كلمات: مركز علمي شرعي عالمي مستقل، فهو مركز علمي لأن الأمور العملية لها مؤسساتها، شرعي فلا يهتم بالعلوم الدنيوية إلا ما كان المفتي مضطرا إليه في تصور الأمور حتى يتسنى له الحكم فيها، عالمي فليس مختصا بموريتانيا وحدها ولا بالعرب ولا بالأفارقة فهو للعالم كله، مستقل فليس تابعا لأي توجه دعوي أو سياسي أو غير ذلك، مرجعيته رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم والمهاجرون والأنصار ومن تبعهم بإحسان.

وبين فضيلة الشيخ أن المركز يقوم على ركيزتين أساسيتين: الركيزة الأولى هي العلم، والركيزة الثانية العمل، فله برنامج علمي يدرس فيه الطلاب ثلاثة وستون علما من العلوم الشرعية ومكملاتها، يصل الطالب بعد تخرجه ودراسته لهذه المتون الستة والستين درجة الدكتوراه في كل هذه التخصصات،

والركيزة الثانية للمركز هي الجانب التربوي فالعلم دون العمل لا فائدة فيه فهو سلاح ذو حدين إما أن يكون حجة للإنسان وإما أن يكون حجة عليه، مستشهدا بإبليس لما علم ولم يعلم بما علم.

وقال الشيخ إنهم مازالوا في بداية الطريق، يكفيهم أن بداية الطريق قد بدأت وأن القطار قد انطلق.

وختم فضيلة الشيخ كلمته بشكر الحاضرين والداعمين والراعين لهذا لحفل.

بدوره أكد مدير المركز الدكتور محمد المختار ولد محمد المامي في هذه المناسبة أنه قد تحقق في هذه السنة الكثير مما خطط له، ، فقد أنهيت المقررات الدراسية في أوقاتها المحددة لها، وجرت الامتحانات والمسابقات في جو مميز لله الحمد، ذاكرا من بين الأهداف التي تحققت:

عقد الملتقى الفقهي الأول في هذه السنة: حيث قدمت فيه بحوث مميزة، قدمت رؤية مؤصلة في قضايا معاصرة كانت مثارا لنقاش مستفيض من طرف العلماء، خلصوا منها لقرارات وتوصيات هامة، سيكون لها الأثر البارز في توجيه الفتوى في تلك الإشكالات وستصدر بحوثه قريبا إن شاء الله تعالى في مجلة محكمة.
- وأقيمت دورات علمية وتكوينية استفاد منها الطاقم التدريسي والإداري للمركز، وجمهور معتبر من طلبة العلم.

- وتم تحقيق ونشر كتابين من أمهات النصوص المعتمدة في المركز حفظا ودراسة، بالإضافة إلى البرنامج العلمي المقرر في المركز في مراحله المختلفة.

- إعداد 90% من المقررات غير المتنية.

- تزويد المكتبة بمجموعة كبيرة من أمهات المصادر والمراجع.

- تم تنظيم المسابقة السنوية للمركز لاختيار الدفعات التي ستلتحق بالمركز السنة القادمة، وقد دأب المركز منذ تأسيسه على إقامة هذه المسابقة قبل نهاية كل سنة دراسية حتى يتسنى للطلاب الجدد الانطلاق مع زملائهم القدامى في وقت واحد، وينهوا مقرراتهم في الأوقات المقررة لها.

وأضاف المدير العام للمركز أنهم في هذا اليوم يحتفون بتخريج خمس دفعات من المركز، أربع منها من مراحل المركز المختلفة:

دفعة من الإعدادية

دفعة من الثانوية

دفعة من الجامعة

دفعة من المدرج الأول من المرحلة العليا (الدراسات العليا)

وأما الدفعة الخامسة فهي الدفعة الثانية من طلاب الدورات المرشحين من رابطة الاتحاد الوطني لجمعيات مدارس القرآن الكريم بالسنغال الشقيقة، التي يحضر معنا في هذا الحفل البهيج كوكبة من علمائها ودعاتها لمشاركتنا حفلنا المبارك، فمرحبا بهم وأهلا وسهلا.

وذكر الدكتور أن المركز يعد لإطلاق مشاريع هامة منها:

التهيئة لإنشاء مقر مميز يليق بمكانة المؤسسة، ويستوعب كافة بناها التحتية، من فصول دراسية ومكاتب إدارية وسكن وأماكن للعبادة والمطالعة والترفيه والصحة.

إطلاق المدرج الثاني من مدارج المرحلة العليا (مدرج القرآن والسنة).

وقد شكر المدير الحضور على تلبية دعوة المركز ومشاركتهم البهجة في هذا الصرح العلمي المعطاء والدوحة الغناء.

بدوره أكد رئيس مصلحة الشؤون الإسلامية بولاية نواكشوط الجنوبية على أهمية الدور الذي يقوم به المركز، وفي ختام الحفل تم تكريم المتفوقين من الطلاب وبعض العمال والموظفين
body_en:
His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew (may God the Exalted preserve him) chaired, on the evening of Tuesday 28 Shawwal 1437 AH, corresponding to 02/08/2016, the closing ceremony of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars for the academic year 1437 AH, corresponding to 2015/2016, under the motto 'Perseverance is the secret of success'.

His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew, president of the Centre, began his address by welcoming the honoured audience and those who had been invited but had not been able to attend, praying that God accept from them all;

noting that their presence that evening was the crowning of the work of the Centre and of its students, who had expended their efforts and had learned. He added that the daily rate of memorisation among the Centre's students comes to nearly thirteen hadiths and one hundred and thirteen lines of the didactic poems, besides the memorisation of the other prose books.

The Sheikh stated the Centre's mission compressed into four words: a scholarly, Sharia-based, international, independent centre. It is scholarly, because practical affairs have their own institutions; Sharia-based, in that it concerns itself with the worldly sciences only so far as the jurist issuing an opinion is obliged to know them in order to form a picture of a matter and so be able to rule upon it; international, in that it is not confined to Mauritania alone, nor to the Arabs, nor to the Africans — it is for the whole world; and independent, in that it is not attached to any tendency, whether of religious outreach or political or otherwise, its point of reference being the Messenger of God, God bless him and grant him peace, and the Emigrants and the Helpers and those who followed them in doing good.

His Eminence explained that the Centre rests on two fundamental supports: the first is knowledge, and the second is action. It has a scholarly programme in which the students study sixty-three of the Sharia sciences and their ancillaries; after graduating and studying these sixty-six texts the student reaches the level of a doctorate in all these specialisms.

The Centre's second support is the formative side, for knowledge without action is of no benefit: it is a double-edged weapon, either an argument in a person's favour or an argument against him. He cited Iblis in evidence, who knew and did not act upon what he knew.

The Sheikh said that they are still at the beginning of the road, and that it is enough for them that the beginning of the road has been made and that the train has set off.

His Eminence closed his address by thanking those present and the supporters and patrons of this ceremony.

For his part the Centre's director, Dr Muhammad al-Mukhtar Ould Muhammad al-Mami, affirmed on this occasion that much of what had been planned had been achieved this year: the courses of study had been completed at the times set for them, and the examinations and competitions had been held in an excellent atmosphere, praise be to God. Among the objectives achieved he mentioned:

The holding of the First Juristic Forum this year, at which outstanding papers were presented, setting out a well-grounded view of contemporary questions that became the occasion of extensive debate among the scholars, from which they arrived at important resolutions and recommendations that will have a marked effect in guiding the issuing of legal opinions on those difficulties. Its papers will be published shortly, God the Exalted willing, in a peer-reviewed journal.
- Scholarly and training courses were held, from which the Centre's teaching and administrative staff and a considerable body of students of the sacred sciences benefited.

- Two of the principal texts prescribed at the Centre for memorisation and study were critically edited and published, in addition to the scholarly programme prescribed at the Centre in its various stages.

- Ninety per cent of the non-versified course materials were prepared.

- The library was supplied with a large collection of the major sources and references.

- The Centre's annual competition was organised to select the intakes that will join the Centre next year. Since its founding the Centre has made a practice of holding this competition before the end of each academic year, so that the new students can start together with their older colleagues at one and the same time and finish their courses at the times appointed for them.

The Centre's director general added that on this day they are celebrating the graduation of five intakes from the Centre, four of them from the Centre's various stages:

an intake from the preparatory stage

an intake from the secondary stage

an intake from the university stage

an intake from the first tier of the higher stage (postgraduate studies)

As for the fifth intake, it is the second intake of course students nominated by the League of the National Union of Qur'an School Associations in the fraternal Republic of Senegal, a distinguished company of whose scholars and callers to Islam is present with us at this joyful ceremony to share our blessed occasion with us — so welcome to them, and may they be at ease.

The doctor mentioned that the Centre is preparing to launch important projects, among them:

Preparations for the building of a distinguished headquarters befitting the institution's standing and accommodating all its infrastructure — classrooms, administrative offices, accommodation, and places for worship, for reading, for recreation and for health care.

The launch of the second of the tiers of the higher stage (the tier of the Qur'an and the Sunnah).

The director thanked those present for answering the Centre's invitation and for sharing in the joy at this bountiful edifice of learning, this verdant garden.

For his part the head of the Islamic Affairs Department of the wilaya of Nouakchott South affirmed the importance of the role the Centre plays; and at the close of the ceremony the outstanding students and some of the workers and staff were honoured.

flags.arabic: ثلاثة وستون علما ... لهذه المتون الستة والستين
flags.context: the account of the Centre's scholarly programme
options: translate both figures as they stand, sixty-three and sixty-six, and flag
read both as the same figure
flags.note: SOURCE DEFECT, recorded not fixed (house rule 11): the same sentence gives sixty-three sciences and then sixty-six texts. One of the two figures is wrong, or the sciences and the texts are being counted differently and the record does not say how. Both have been translated as written and neither has been harmonised.

flags.arabic: يصل الطالب ... درجة الدكتوراه في كل هذه التخصصات
flags.context: the director's description of the programme's outcome
options: reaches the level of a doctorate in all these specialisms
attains a standard equivalent to a doctorate in all these specialisms
flags.note: EDITORIALLY SENSITIVE. In English this reads as a claim that the Centre confers doctorates in sixty-odd disciplines, which is a claim about accreditation that may not be intended and that could be challenged. The Arabic says the student 'reaches the level of' (يصل ... درجة), which is a claim about attainment, not about a conferred degree. The English keeps the Arabic's wording; the display should not present it as an accreditation claim.

flags.arabic: مستشهدا بإبليس لما علم ولم يعلم بما علم
flags.context: the Sheikh's point that knowledge without action is a double-edged weapon
options: who knew and did not act upon what he knew
who had knowledge and did not put his knowledge into practice
flags.note: SOURCE DEFECT: 'ولم يعلم بما علم' as printed says 'and did not know what he knew', which is incoherent. The intended verb is almost certainly يعمل ('act'), giving the standard formula 'he knew and did not act upon his knowledge', which is what the surrounding argument about العلم and العمل requires. Preserved unchanged in body_ar and rendered on the intended reading in body_en, with this note (house rule 11).
A classical metaphor: a دوحة is a great spreading tree and غنّاء means densely leaved. Rendered as an image rather than transliterated; any of the three would serve and the choice is stylistic.

translator_notes: A news report written by the site. The addresses of the Sheikh and of the director general are reported indirectly throughout; nothing appears as direct speech except where the Arabic itself is direct.
المنظومات are the didactic poems that Mauritanian students memorise; 'lines' renders أبيات, the verse line.
المهاجرون والأنصار rendered 'the Emigrants and the Helpers', the standard English for the two groups of Companions.
'مدرج' in the Centre's usage is a tier or stage of the higher programme, not a lecture theatre.
SOURCE DEFECTS preserved in body_ar: a doubled comma after 'ما خطط له'; 'لهذا لحفل' for 'لهذا الحفل'.
The CMS timestamp (3 August 2016) is a bulk-upload date; the body dates the ceremony to the evening of Tuesday 2 August 2016.
